name: IntegrateIT Bond Fireplace
notes: Convenience control of one Smart by Bond fireplace (device type FP) over the Bond Home v2 local HTTP API, with real push state feedback. Flame on/off with level stepping where the device exposes it, an independent FpFan (on/off/speed) that is never touched by a flame command, and light where the fireplace was learned with one. This is convenience control of an appliance that keeps its own listed safety systems — the driver claims no flame supervision, ignition safety, or auto-off it does not have.
